recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, low-angle shot of three rock musicians performing live, characterized by intense red and yellow stage lighting against a deep black background. The figures are captured in dynamic, expressive poses with motion blur, wearing ornate, gold-trimmed stage costumes. A circular graphic emblem containing text sits in the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast red highlights against deep black shadows
Circular graphic element contrasting with the organic, blurred forms of the musicians
Warm yellow accents on costume details and skin highlights
coreInvariants: Extreme red color cast on skin tones
Motion blur on the central figure's hands and instruments
Deep black negative space in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, with the central figure slightly lower and larger in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the bright red highlights on their chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the circular logo in the top left, moves down to the left performer, across to the central figure, and up to the right performer's expressive face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black space at the top and between the figures emphasizes the stage lighting effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Red (primary lighting and skin tones)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden Yellow (costume trim and brightest highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation in the reds; very low value in the shadows creating a 'crushed' black look.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to red, yellow, and black
Avoid cool tones like blue or green

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and bold sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Arched text following a circular path
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exclamation point integrated into the central horizontal text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, slanted sans-serif for the central word paired with a heavy slab serif for the circular perimeter text.
graphicDevices: Concentric circular rings framing the text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif feel of the perimeter text.
Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for the central text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast concert photo of a 1970s rock band with three members. Use intense red stage lighting that washes over their faces and costumes. The costumes should have gold embroidery. The background must be solid black. Include motion blur on the instruments.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a circular emblem in the top left. The emblem consists of two concentric yellow rings. Inside the rings, place arched slab-serif text at the top and bottom. In the center of the circle, place a bold, slanted red word with a yellow outline.

verificationChecks: Is the red lighting the dominant visual feature?
Are the shadows deep black without detail?
Is the text arranged in a circular format in the upper left?
Do the costumes feature gold/yellow ornate details?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red color cast
Complexity of the gold costume embroidery
postGenerationChecks: Verify the circular text path is smooth
Ensure the gold trim on costumes pops against the red
Confirm the background is sufficiently dark
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [1970s concert photography] with [extreme red saturation] and [circular graphic emblem] to create a [high-energy rock aesthetic].
